name: Haría (Spain)
description: White field with a blue triangle at the hoist and yellow and green stripes across the lower middle, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Haría (a palm tree and a tower).
history: Municipal flag of Haría; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
yellow and green stripes below the centre
Haría arms — palm tree and tower
